entries.zh: 懂得技艺、通晓学问（认得某种手艺或学科）
entries.en: to know an art or science; to be versed in a craft or learning

entries.zh: 会说自己的道理、能讲出个所以然；能言善辩
entries.en: to know how to give one's reasons; to be able to argue one's case
entries.notes: H「吻」与 R「lou bun」未能确解（或为「论本/嘴唇」之讹），释义主要依 L「saber decir su razón」推断

entries.zh: 好问好究、爱寻根问底（好奇地探问）
entries.en: to know inquisitively; curious to ask, to probe by questioning

entries.zh: 认得、认出；认识
entries.en: to know; to recognize, identify
entries.notes: R 对音 xin 与「認」读音不合，或为污损误读，释义依 H「認」与 L 推断

entries.zh: 识得经过、凭经历认得（相识相认）
entries.en: to know by experience or acquaintance; to recognize (someone) from having known him

entries.zh: 口吻、说话的腔调口气
entries.en: tone and manner of speech; turn of phrase
entries.notes: L 词头仅存 'saber.'，与「口吻」（cou bun）的对应方式存疑

entries.zh: 在行、内行（懂本行）
entries.en: to know one's trade; to be expert or conversant in a line of work

entries.zh: 知识、见识
entries.en: knowledge; knowing

entries.zh: 谙练、娴熟（了如指掌）
entries.en: to know perfectly; to be thoroughly versed and practiced

entries.zh: 识香臭、辨好歹（知好知坏）
entries.en: to know good from bad; to tell fragrant from foul

entries.zh: 识艰苦、吃过苦头（历经好歹；右缘另有「知头尾」批注）
entries.en: to know hardship, to have known good and bad; (marginal note: to know a matter from start to finish)

entries.zh: 识咸酸苦淡、尝遍诸般滋味（历尽好歹）
entries.en: to know the flavors of life, salty, sour, bitter and bland; to know good and bad by experience

entries.zh: 识到底、知根知底（全都知道）
entries.en: to know it all; to know a thing to the very bottom

entries.zh: 识到详细、知道得详尽（底细都明白）
entries.en: to know it all; to know down to every detail

entries.zh: 识江湖、通晓世情（阅历深、见多识广）
entries.en: to know the wide world; worldly-wise, experienced in men and affairs

entries.zh: 知头尾、知道来龙去脉（知好知歹）
entries.en: to know good and bad; to know a matter from beginning to end

entries.zh: 识一个皮、只知表面（皮毛之识，一知半解）
entries.en: to know superficially; skin-deep knowledge

entries.zh: 识事、懂事（知人情事理）
entries.en: to know how to conduct oneself; to be sensible, versed in matters

entries.zh: 识小礼、懂小节（知礼数）
entries.en: to know courtesy; versed in the lesser points of etiquette

entries.zh: 识礼、懂礼（知礼守礼）
entries.en: to know propriety; courteous, well-mannered

entries.zh: 有面目、有体面（懂得分寸而有脸面）
entries.en: to know what is fitting; to have face and standing
entries.notes: L「知所宜」与「有面目」（有体面）之间系推断性对应，或谓知礼识体故有体面

entries.zh: 学识较高、见识高明〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to know more; superior knowledge or insight (text damaged, gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: M 栏「灼」为墨渍残损，「高灼」非通行词形，或涉「高明／灼见」之义

entries.zh: 只会一点、略知一二（懂得有限）
entries.en: to know only a little; to know but poorly
entries.notes: H「句」与 R「cu ey」未对应通行词形，凭 L「saber poco」与 M「會」推断
